description: This file defines the JwtIssuerOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options related to JWT token issuance, including claims like issuer, subject, audience, token validity period, JWT ID generator, and signing credentials.

classes.name: JwtIssuerOptions
classes.description: A class representing options for JWT token issuer configuration, including claim details, token validity period, and signing credentials.

methods.name: JtiGenerator
methods.description: A property delegating to generate a new GUID string for the JWT ID claim.

methods.name: Expiration
methods.description: A computed property returning the token's expiration time based on the issued time plus the validity duration.

methods.name: IssuedAt
methods.description: A computed property returning the current UTC time as the token's issued time.

methods.name: NotBefore
methods.description: A property returning the current UTC time, indicating when the token becomes valid.
